reason: The hypothesis combines the established observation of edge-dislocation-dominated plasticity and strength plateaus in refractory HEAs (from P1-P3, P5, P13, P16, P17, P42, P47) with the recent finding that short-range order alters plasticity in HfNbTaTiZr (P28). It proposes a specific causal link—that SRO enhances lattice distortion to promote edge dislocation slip and thereby causes the plateau, reduced thermal expansion, and elastic changes—which is not stated in any single passage. This synthesis of SRO effects with the edge-dislocation mechanism for the specific HfNbTaTiZr alloy goes beyond the individual sources.
